# PythonAnywhere

> PythonAnywhere is a cloud-based Python IDE and web hosting platform for deploying Django, Flask, web2py, and Bottle applications with pre-installed packages and virtualenv support.

PythonAnywhere provides an integrated development and hosting environment for Python web applications, eliminating the need for local setup and server management. The platform is owned by Anaconda and serves developers from beginners to enterprises with educational and professional hosting tiers.

## Key Topics

- Python web hosting
- Django deployment
- Flask hosting
- Cloud IDE
- virtualenvs
- web2py
- Bottle framework
- pip package manager
- git version control
- free tier
- web application deployment
- Python frameworks
- easy setup
- GDPR compliance
- Anaconda
